Summary:
# Fordjent Agent Harness — Architecture Overview

Fordjent is a **Forgejo-driven autonomous coding agent harness**. It listens to Forgejo webhooks, spawns per-issue/session agents, and lets each agent use LLM-powered tools (read_file, write_file, bash, git, Forgejo API) to implement code, manage PRs, and coordinate multi-agent parallel work.

---

## 1. Entry Points and Wiring

### `cmd/fordjent/main.go`

The `main()` function wires 4 top-level components:

```
main()
  ├── config.Load("fordjent.yaml")       // YAML config with env-var expansion + defaults
  ├── event.NewBus()                     // In-process fan-out bus
  ├── session.NewManager(cfg, bus)       // Session manager (persistent session store, lifecycle, merge queue, scheduler, cost tracker, etc.)
  ├── webhook.NewRouter(cfg, bus, logger) // HTTP server: /acp/v1/events, /healthz, /status, /metrics, /admin, /dashboard, /trace/
  ├── scanner.NewScanner(...)            // Optional: periodic repo scanner → synthetic events
  └── ←ctx.Done() → drain goroutines
```

**Startup sequence**:
1. Load config from YAML (env vars expanded)
2. Create the event **Bus** (unbounded fan-out to subscribers)
3. Create the **Session Manager** — wires in lifecycle tracker, merge queue client, scheduler, cost tracker, scaffold detector, spec PR manager, auto-registrar, policy detector, and session store (SQLite)
4. Create the **Webhook Router** — HTTP server listening on configured host:port. Endpoints: `/acp/v1/events` (webhook receiver), `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/status`, `/metrics` (Prometheus), `/tokens-per-minute`, `/activity`, `/trace/`, `/dashboard`, `/admin`, `/acp/v1/stream` (SSE live events), `/acp/v1/test-merge-webhook`
5. Wire lifecycle + forgejo client onto router (done after manager creation so references exist)
6. Start **webhook server** in goroutine
7. Start **manager event loop** in goroutine
8. Optionally start **periodic scanner** in goroutine

**Shutdown**: On signal, drain the manager (60s timeout), stop scanner, shut down HTTP server.

---

## 2. Major Packages

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `session/manager.go` | **Session lifecycle**: creates/destroys agents, dispatches events to sessions, handles auto-retry, PM reactivation, scaffold detection, role gating, merge event post-processing. |
| `session/agent.go` | **LLM agent loop**: `Agent.ProcessEvent()` builds context (issue + comments + parent issues), constructs system prompt with role-specific instructions, runs the LLM ↔ tool execution loop with steering, compaction, cost tracking, stall detection, and session termination. |
| `agent/turn.go` + `agent/context.go` | **Turn Executor + Context Tracker**: Wraps each LLM call with budget checks, automatic context compaction at 80% window, latency/cost telemetry, per-turn steering messages (budget warnings, per-tool repeat nudges, bug-report reproduction steering, hard gate at turn 15). |
| `provider/client.go` + `provider/retry.go` + `provider/fallback.go` | **LLM provider abstraction**: OpenAI-compatible chat API client with retry policy (exponential backoff + jitter), cost calculation, cache-control hints for KV-cache providers, concurrent-call semaphore, and fallback provider wrapping. |
| `tool/registry.go` | **Tool registry**: Thread-safe map of named tools. Provides `Register()`, `Get()`, `Execute()`, `Tools()` (for LLM schema), `ToolsExcluding()` (for hiding tools), scope-mutating methods (`SetWriteScope`, `SetPRScope`, `SetBashScope`). |
| `tool/forgejo_tools.go` | **Forgejo API tools**: comment, create_issue, create_pr, merge_pr, milestone, set_milestone, ping_parent, sub_issues, etc. |
| `tool/local_tools.go` | **Local execution tools**: read_file, write_file, bash (shell commands), git (branch/diff/log/status/push/pull). |
| `tool/openspec_tools.go` | **OpenSpec tools**: get_tasks, propose, archive_change, mark_task, read_spec, read_change. |
| `webhook/router.go` | **Webhook receiver**: Validates HMAC signatures, deduplicates by delivery ID (30s TTL), parses Forgejo webhook payloads into normalized `event.Event`, filters agent-originated events (hidden marker `<!-- ford -->` + bot sender check), corrects PR session keys for Forgejo v9, and publishes to the event bus. |
| `event/event.go` | **Event types + event bus**: 16 event types (IssueOpened, PullRequestMerged, etc.), `Bus` with pub/sub channel fan-out. |
| `lifecycle/lifecycle.go` | **Session persistence tracker**: SQLite DB recording `created → working → completed/failed_*` transitions, per-turn tracking (tool_calls, latency, tokens, errors), blocked branch tracking, scheduled SSE broadcast on every event. |
| `lifecycle/fsm.go` | **Issue FSM state machine**: 12 states (opened → needs-role → ready → in_progress → planning → plan-approved → implementing → review → merging → done + blocked). Label-to-state mapping with priority. |
| `mergequeue/queue.go` | **File-gate merge queue**: Before PR creation, compares changed files against all open PRs. If any overlap exists, blocks creation with a message listing conflicting PRs/files. |
| `scheduler/scheduler.go` + `scheduler/retry.go` | **Dependency scheduler**: Parses `Depends on: #N` from issue bodies, tracks dependency satisfaction, creates `automerge` label on PRs, handles PM reactivation, and retries label-based automerge until success or max retries. |
| `stalegate/stalegate.go` | **Stale branch detection**: Uses `git merge-base` to check if branch has been rebased against origin/main. If stale and rebase fails, returns an error message to the agent instructing manual resolution. |
| `scaffold/scaffold.go` | **Empty-repo protection**: Detects repos with no meaningful scaffold files and creates a scaffold issue to seed the repo. |
| `cost/cost.go` | **Usage/cost tracking**: Records per-session/provider/model token usage and USD cost in SQLite. |
| `metrics/metrics.go` | **Prometheus metrics**: Counters for events, sessions, LLM calls, tool calls, retries, tokens, cost. |
| `config/config.go` | **Configuration**: YAML config with extensive defaults. Supports per-role provider selection, budget limits, sandbox config, role tokens. |
| `forgejo/client.go` + `forgejo/util.go` | **Forgejo HTTP client**: All REST API operations against Forgejo (CRUD on issues, PRs, comments, labels, milestones, users, commits, branches, webhooks). |
| `memory/memory.go` | **Session memory**: JSONL append, compaction cron, git log integration. |
| `policy/policy.go` | **Repo policy detection**: Reads repo topics/settings to detect merge policies (`no-auto-merge`, `require-review`, `plan-first`). |
| `sandbox/bwrap.go` etc. | **Sandboxing**: bwrap sandbox profiles restricting tool execution. |
| `speccycle/` | **Spec lifecycle**: Manages spec PRs, tasks, and archive workflow. |
| `eval/` | **Evaluation harness**: Test scenarios and scoring for benchmarking. |
| `e2e/e2e_test.go` | **End-to-end tests**: Integrates actual forgejo + webhook + session manager. |

---

## 3. Agent Loop

### Flow: Webhook → Event → Session → Agent → Tools → LLM → Response

```
Forgejo Webhook
     ↓
Router.handleWebhook()
  - HMAC validation
  - Dedup (seenEvents sync.Map, 30s TTL)
  - Parse payload → normalizeEvent() → event.Event
  - Filter agent-originated events (marker <!-- ford -->)
  - Filter comments on closed PRs
  - bus.Publish()
     ↓
Manager.handleEvent()
  - Various gates (scaffold, role tag, green-light, automerge)
  - manager.getOrCreate() → creates Session + goroutine if needed
  - sess.events chan <- event
     ↓
runSession(sess)
  - detectRoleFromSession() → "pm"/"implementer"/"reviewer"/etc.
  - NewAgent(cfg, sess, ..., role)
  - Loop: for { select { case <-sess.events: ProcessEvent(evt) } }
     ↓
Agent.ProcessEvent()
  - addReaction(eyes)
  - detectAnalysisMode(), detectIssueState(), detectRepoPolicy()
  - buildSystemPrompt() → role-specific prompt + tool descriptions
  - buildContext() → issue body, comments, parent context, memory
  - For PR review events: fetch PR branch, checkout
  - Build messages = [system prompt + context + event message]
  - For turn = 0 to maxTurns:
    - TurnExecutor.Run() → LLM.Chat() (+ retry)
    - If no tool calls → return success
    - Execute each tool call via registry.Execute()
    - Append tool results to messages
    - Apply steering messages (budget warnings, per-tool nudges)
    - If forgejo_create_pr + implementer → stop (PR already created)
    - Detect stall (3 identical turn signatures)
     ↓
Tool execution (bash, write_file, git, forgejo_comment, etc.)
  - Each tool is a struct implementing Tool interface:
    - Name() string
    - Description() string
    - Parameters() map[string]interface{}
    - Execute(ctx, args json.RawMessage) (string, error)
  - Executed inside the agent's repo directory (repoDir)
     ↓
On success: lifecycle.OnSessionComplete(), post commit status, log time
On failure: lifecycle.OnSessionFailedMaxTurns / OnSessionFailedError
```

### Turn Executor (`internal/agent/turn.go`)

The `TurnExecutor.Run()` method wraps each LLM call with:
1. **Budget check** (`costTracker.CheckBudget()`)
2. **Context compaction** if estimated tokens > 80% of window (truncates old turns, keeps system prompt + last N turns)
3. LLM API call via `llm.Chat()` (with retry baked in)
4. Cost calculation and recording
5. Turn telemetry logging

### Steering Messages

The executor injects steering messages at the end of each turn:
- **Per-tool repeat nudges**: If `git` called >4x, `bash` >5x, etc., inject a message telling the agent to stop exploring
- **Bug-repro steering**: For bug-report issues, nudge agent to reproduce before fixing (turns 2–5)
- **Duplicate output nudge**: If bash/git returns same output twice, tell agent to proceed
- **Hard gate at turn 15**: Remove exploration tools (read_file, list_issues, etc.), keep write_file + bash + git + forgejo_create_pr
- **Budget thresholds**: 40%/60%/80%/90% turn-budget warnings

### Stall Detection

Tracks the last 3 turn signatures (sorted tool calls). If all 3 are identical, injects a warning message.

---

## 4. Event System

### Event Types (`internal/event/event.go`)

```go
type Type string

const (
    IssueOpened                Type = "issues.opened"
    IssueClosed                Type = "issues.closed"
    IssueReopened              Type = "issues.reopened"
    IssueLabelUpdated          Type = "issues.label_updated"
    IssueEdited                Type = "issues.edited"
    IssueCommentCreated        Type = "issue_comment.created"     // human comment, PM follow-up, scheduler unblock
    IssueCommentEdited         Type = "issue_comment.edited"
    PullRequestOpened          Type = "pull_request.opened"
    PullRequestClosed          Type = "pull_request.closed"
    PullRequestMerged          Type = "pull_request.merged"
    PullRequestLabelUpdated    Type = "pull_request.label_updated"
    PullRequestSync            Type = "pull_request.synchronize"
    PullRequestReviewComment   Type = "pull_request_review_comment.created"
    Push                       Type = "push"
    PMReactivate               Type = "pm.reactivate"             // synthetic: all sub-issues done
    SpecPRMerged               Type = "spec.pr_merged"            // synthetic
)
```

### Event Structure
```go
type Event struct {
    ID, Type, Repository      string
    IssueNumber, PRNumber, TriggeringIssue  int
    Sender, Action            string
    SessionKey                string           // derived from issue/PR number
    Payload                   map[string]interface{}
}
```

### Event Bus
```go
type Bus struct {
    mu          sync.RWMutex
    subscribers []chan *Event
}
```
- `Subscribe()` → returns buffered channel (256)
- `Publish(ctx, evt)` → fan-out to all subscribers (non-blocking, drops if full)
- `Unsubscribe(ch)` → removes and closes channel

### Dedup Strategy
- **Delivery-level**: `seenEvents sync.Map` keyed by Forgejo delivery header, 30s TTL, cleaned by periodic goroutine
- **Agent-event filtering**: `isAgentEvent()` in router checks `<!-- ford -->` marker in comment/issue/PR bodies + bot sender identity for comments + "always pass" for push events and merged PRs

### Key Event Handlers in Manager
| Event | Handler |
|-------|---------|
| `PullRequestMerged` | OnPRMerged → unblock dependents, PM reactivation, merge-queue auto-requeue |
| `IssueLabelUpdated` | FSM state transitions, green-light detection, role assignment, non-role events dropped |
| `IssueCommentCreated` | Scaffold answer, scheduler unblock detection, PR review redirect (-fix sessions) |
| `IssueOpened` | Role gate, scaffold detection, green-light processing |
| `PullRequestLabelUpdated` | Automerge detection → direct merge attempt |
| `Push` (to main) | Close scaffold issues, unblock dependents |

## 6. Session Lifecycle

### State Machine (two layers)

**Session-level** (`lifecycle/lifecycle.go`, SQLite `session_transitions` table):
```
created → working → pr_created → completed
                ↓
       working → failed_max_turns  (labeled: fordjent/failed:max-turns, auto-retryable)
       working → failed_error      (labeled: fordjent/failed:error, blocked)
       working → blocked           (merge queue block, tracks branch for auto-requeue)
```

**Issue FSM** (`lifecycle/fsm.go`, from labels):
```
opened → needs-role → ready → in_progress → implementing → review → merging → done
         ↕ planning → plan-approved
                      ↕ blocked
```

### Session Creation Flow
1. `Manager.handleEvent()` receives event
2. Various gates apply:
   - **Scaffold detection**: Empty repos → create scaffold issue, block other issues
   - **Role gate**: Issues without role tag → add `needs-role` label + guidance
   - **Green-light**: If label is `plan-approved`/`ready`/`implementing`, create session with that role
   - **Automerge**: `automerge` label on PR → direct API merge (no LLM)
   - **PR review fix**: Human comment on PR → create `-fix` session with implementer role
3. `manager.getOrCreate()`: Creates Session + repo clone → starts `runSession()` goroutine
4. Session dispatches events from its `events` channel (buffered 64)

### Auto-Retry
- Scheduled every 5 minutes (configurable)
- Scans for `fordjent/failed:max-turns` labeled issues
- Resets labels (`fordjent/failed:max-turns` → removed), adds `ready`/`in_progress`
- Dispatches synthetic synthetic event
- After N retries (default 2), perma-blocks with `fordjent/failed:max-retries`

### Periodic Maintenance
- **Reaper** (every 1min): Kills idle sessions exceeding `idle_timeout`
- **Cleanup** (every 1h): Archives workDirs older than `cleanup_archive_days`
- **Stuck detection** (every 30min): Identifies working sessions idle >15min
- **Recovery** (every 1h): Nudges inactive implementer sessions via comment
- **Reconcile** (every 2h): `scheduler.ReconcileBlocked()` — safety net for missed webhooks

---

## 7. Merge Workflow

### PR Creation
1. Agent calls `forgejo_create_pr` tool
2. **Auto-rebase**: `stalegate.IsStale(repoDir, "main")` — fetches + check-ancestor + tries `git rebase origin/main` + force-push. If conflicts, blocks with instructions.
3. **Merge queue**: `mergequeue.CheckGate(repo, headBranch, baseBranch)` — fetches all open PRs, compares changed files (`/api/v1/repos/{repo}/pulls/{N}/files`). If overlap, returns error with conflicting PR numbers.
4. If gates pass, creates PR via `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
5. Sets `automerge` label
6. Posts "Ready for Review" comment with `<!-- ford -->` marker
7. Records `pr_created` lifecycle transition

### PR Review
1. `PullRequestOpened` event → reviewer session created
2. Reviewer reads PR diff via `forgejo_list_prs` + `forgejo_pr_files`
3. If issues found → comments requesting changes
4. If correct → calls `forgejo_merge_pr` or posts review
5. Reviewer policy enforcement (from repo topics): `no-auto-merge` → comment only; `require-review` → only merge if `approved` label present

### Merge
- **Automerge label**: Sets `automerge` label on PR. Manager detects label → tries API merge directly (bypasses LLM). Tries `merge`, `squash`, `rebase-merge` in order.
- **Direct API merge**: `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{N}/merge` → `PullRequestMerged` event → triggers scheduler + PM reactivation + merge-queue re-dispatch.
- **Review merge**: Agent calls `forgejo_merge_pr` tool (with approval check for review-only repos)

### Merge-Queue Auto-Requeue
When a PR merges:
1. Check `blocked_branches` table for this repo
2. For each blocked branch: `CheckGate()` — if cleared, dispatch synthetic `IssueOpened` event to create a new implementer session
3. If gate still blocked but message references the just-merged PR: force-retry anyway (Forgejo state lag)
4. After 2 re-dispatches (`retry_count >= 2`), resolve the branch

### Turn Executor (`internal/agent/turn.go`)

The `TurnExecutor.Run()` method wraps each LLM call with:
1. **Budget check** (`costTracker.CheckBudget()`)
2. **Context compaction** if estimated tokens > 80% of window (truncates old turns, keeps system prompt + last N turns)
3. LLM API call via `llm.Chat()` (with retry baked in)
4. Cost calculation and recording
5. Turn telemetry logging

### Steering Messages

The executor injects steering messages at the end of each turn:
- **Per-tool repeat nudges**: If `git` called >4x, `bash` >5x, etc., inject a message telling the agent to stop exploring
- **Bug-repro steering**: For bug-report issues, nudge agent to reproduce before fixing (turns 2–5)
- **Duplicate output nudge**: If bash/git returns same output twice, tell agent to proceed
- **Hard gate at turn 15**: Remove exploration tools (read_file, list_issues, etc.), keep write_file + bash + git + forgejo_create_pr
- **Budget thresholds**: 40%/60%/80%/90% turn-budget warnings

### Stall Detection

Tracks the last 3 turn signatures (sorted tool calls). If all 3 are identical, injects a warning message.

## 6. Session Lifecycle

### State Machine (two layers)

**Session-level** (`lifecycle/lifecycle.go`, SQLite `session_transitions` table):
```
created → working → pr_created → completed
                ↓
       working → failed_max_turns  (labeled: fordjent/failed:max-turns, auto-retryable)
       working → failed_error      (labeled: fordjent/failed:error, blocked)
       working → blocked           (merge queue block, tracks branch for auto-requeue)
```

**Issue FSM** (`lifecycle/fsm.go`, from labels):
```
opened → needs-role → ready → in_progress → implementing → review → merging → done
         ↕ planning → plan-approved
                      ↕ blocked
```

### Session Creation Flow
1. `Manager.handleEvent()` receives event
2. Various gates apply:
   - **Scaffold detection**: Empty repos → create scaffold issue, block other issues
   - **Role gate**: Issues without role tag → add `needs-role` label + guidance
   - **Green-light**: If label is `plan-approved`/`ready`/`implementing`, create session with that role
   - **Automerge**: `automerge` label on PR → direct API merge (no LLM)
   - **PR review fix**: Human comment on PR → create `-fix` session with implementer role
3. `manager.getOrCreate()`: Creates Session + repo clone → starts `runSession()` goroutine
4. Session dispatches events from its `events` channel (buffered 64)

### Auto-Retry
- Scheduled every 5 minutes (configurable)
- Scans for `fordjent/failed:max-turns` labeled issues
- Resets labels (`fordjent/failed:max-turns` → removed), adds `ready`/`in_progress`
- Dispatches synthetic synthetic event
- After N retries (default 2), perma-blocks with `fordjent/failed:max-retries`

### Periodic Maintenance
- **Reaper** (every 1min): Kills idle sessions exceeding `idle_timeout`
- **Cleanup** (every 1h): Archives workDirs older than `cleanup_archive_days`
- **Stuck detection** (every 30min): Identifies working sessions idle >15min
- **Recovery** (every 1h): Nudges inactive implementer sessions via comment
- **Reconcile** (every 2h): `scheduler.ReconcileBlocked()` — safety net for missed webhooks

---

## 7. Merge Workflow

### PR Creation
1. Agent calls `forgejo_create_pr` tool
2. **Auto-rebase**: `stalegate.IsStale(repoDir, "main")` — fetches + check-ancestor + tries `git rebase origin/main` + force-push. If conflicts, blocks with instructions.
3. **Merge queue**: `mergequeue.CheckGate(repo, headBranch, baseBranch)` — fetches all open PRs, compares changed files (`/api/v1/repos/{repo}/pulls/{N}/files`). If overlap, returns error with conflicting PR numbers.
4. If gates pass, creates PR via `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
5. Sets `automerge` label
6. Posts "Ready for Review" comment with `<!-- ford -->` marker
7. Records `pr_created` lifecycle transition

### PR Review
1. `PullRequestOpened` event → reviewer session created
2. Reviewer reads PR diff via `forgejo_list_prs` + `forgejo_pr_files`
3. If issues found → comments requesting changes
4. If correct → calls `forgejo_merge_pr` or posts review
5. Reviewer policy enforcement (from repo topics): `no-auto-merge` → comment only; `require-review` → only merge if `approved` label present

### Merge
- **Automerge label**: Sets `automerge` label on PR. Manager detects label → tries API merge directly (bypasses LLM). Tries `merge`, `squash`, `rebase-merge` in order.
- **Direct API merge**: `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{N}/merge` → `PullRequestMerged` event → triggers scheduler + PM reactivation + merge-queue re-dispatch.
- **Review merge**: Agent calls `forgejo_merge_pr` tool (with approval check for review-only repos)

### Merge-Queue Auto-Requeue
When a PR merges:
1. Check `blocked_branches` table for this repo
2. For each blocked branch: `CheckGate()` — if cleared, dispatch synthetic `IssueOpened` event to create a new implementer session
3. If gate still blocked but message references the just-merged PR: force-retry anyway (Forgejo state lag)
4. After 2 re-dispatches (`retry_count >= 2`), resolve the branch

### Turn Executor (`internal/agent/turn.go`)

The `TurnExecutor.Run()` method wraps each LLM call with:
1. **Budget check** (`costTracker.CheckBudget()`)
2. **Context compaction** if estimated tokens > 80% of window (truncates old turns, keeps system prompt + last N turns)
3. LLM API call via `llm.Chat()` (with retry baked in)
4. Cost calculation and recording
5. Turn telemetry logging

### Steering Messages

The executor injects steering messages at the end of each turn:
- **Per-tool repeat nudges**: If `git` called >4x, `bash` >5x, etc., inject a message telling the agent to stop exploring
- **Bug-repro steering**: For bug-report issues, nudge agent to reproduce before fixing (turns 2–5)
- **Duplicate output nudge**: If bash/git returns same output twice, tell agent to proceed
- **Hard gate at turn 15**: Remove exploration tools (read_file, list_issues, etc.), keep write_file + bash + git + forgejo_create_pr
- **Budget thresholds**: 40%/60%/80%/90% turn-budget warnings

### Stall Detection

Tracks the last 3 turn signatures (sorted tool calls). If all 3 are identical, injects a warning message.

## 6. Session Lifecycle

### State Machine (two layers)

**Session-level** (`lifecycle/lifecycle.go`, SQLite `session_transitions` table):
```
created → working → pr_created → completed
                ↓
       working → failed_max_turns  (labeled: fordjent/failed:max-turns, auto-retryable)
       working → failed_error      (labeled: fordjent/failed:error, blocked)
       working → blocked           (merge queue block, tracks branch for auto-requeue)
```

**Issue FSM** (`lifecycle/fsm.go`, from labels):
```
opened → needs-role → ready → in_progress → implementing → review → merging → done
         ↕ planning → plan-approved
                      ↕ blocked
```

### Session Creation Flow
1. `Manager.handleEvent()` receives event
2. Various gates apply:
   - **Scaffold detection**: Empty repos → create scaffold issue, block other issues
   - **Role gate**: Issues without role tag → add `needs-role` label + guidance
   - **Green-light**: If label is `plan-approved`/`ready`/`implementing`, create session with that role
   - **Automerge**: `automerge` label on PR → direct API merge (no LLM)
   - **PR review fix**: Human comment on PR → create `-fix` session with implementer role
3. `manager.getOrCreate()`: Creates Session + repo clone → starts `runSession()` goroutine
4. Session dispatches events from its `events` channel (buffered 64)

### Auto-Retry
- Scheduled every 5 minutes (configurable)
- Scans for `fordjent/failed:max-turns` labeled issues
- Resets labels (`fordjent/failed:max-turns` → removed), adds `ready`/`in_progress`
- Dispatches synthetic synthetic event
- After N retries (default 2), perma-blocks with `fordjent/failed:max-retries`

### Periodic Maintenance
- **Reaper** (every 1min): Kills idle sessions exceeding `idle_timeout`
- **Cleanup** (every 1h): Archives workDirs older than `cleanup_archive_days`
- **Stuck detection** (every 30min): Identifies working sessions idle >15min
- **Recovery** (every 1h): Nudges inactive implementer sessions via comment
- **Reconcile** (every 2h): `scheduler.ReconcileBlocked()` — safety net for missed webhooks

---

## 7. Merge Workflow

### PR Creation
1. Agent calls `forgejo_create_pr` tool
2. **Auto-rebase**: `stalegate.IsStale(repoDir, "main")` — fetches + check-ancestor + tries `git rebase origin/main` + force-push. If conflicts, blocks with instructions.
3. **Merge queue**: `mergequeue.CheckGate(repo, headBranch, baseBranch)` — fetches all open PRs, compares changed files (`/api/v1/repos/{repo}/pulls/{N}/files`). If overlap, returns error with conflicting PR numbers.
4. If gates pass, creates PR via `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
5. Sets `automerge` label
6. Posts "Ready for Review" comment with `<!-- ford -->` marker
7. Records `pr_created` lifecycle transition

### PR Review
1. `PullRequestOpened` event → reviewer session created
2. Reviewer reads PR diff via `forgejo_list_prs` + `forgejo_pr_files`
3. If issues found → comments requesting changes
4. If correct → calls `forgejo_merge_pr` or posts review
5. Reviewer policy enforcement (from repo topics): `no-auto-merge` → comment only; `require-review` → only merge if `approved` label present

### Merge
- **Automerge label**: Sets `automerge` label on PR. Manager detects label → tries API merge directly (bypasses LLM). Tries `merge`, `squash`, `rebase-merge` in order.
- **Direct API merge**: `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{N}/merge` → `PullRequestMerged` event → triggers scheduler + PM reactivation + merge-queue re-dispatch.
- **Review merge**: Agent calls `forgejo_merge_pr` tool (with approval check for review-only repos)

### Merge-Queue Auto-Requeue
When a PR merges:
1. Check `blocked_branches` table for this repo
2. For each blocked branch: `CheckGate()` — if cleared, dispatch synthetic `IssueOpened` event to create a new implementer session
3. If gate still blocked but message references the just-merged PR: force-retry anyway (Forgejo state lag)
4. After 2 re-dispatches (`retry_count >= 2`), resolve the branch

---

## Fordjent — Agent Harness Architecture

**Fordjent** is a Forgejo-driven autonomous coding agent harness. It listens to Forgejo webhooks, spawns per-issue/session LLM agents, and lets each agent use tools (read/write files, bash, git, Forgejo API) to implement code, manage PRs, and coordinate parallel multi-agent work.

---

### High-Level Flow

```
Forgejo webhook ──→ Router (HMAC, dedup, parse) ──→ Event Bus (fan-out)
                                                            │
                                                    handleEvent()
                                                     getOrCreate()
                                                            │
                                              ┌───────────────┴────────┐
                                              │   Session goroutine   │
                                              │   Agent.ProcessEvent()│
                                              │                        │
                                              │  TurnExecutor.Run()    │──→ LLM.Chat()
                                              │      ┌────┐            │
                                              │      │LLM──┤──tool_calls│
                                              │      └────┘     │       │
                                              │     execute_tools│       │
                                              │                    ▼       │
                                              │              forgejo API  │◄─┘
                                              │              bash/git/write
                                              └────────────────────────────┘
                                                            │
                                                    PR created / merged
                                                            │
                                                    Webhook fires → cycle repeats
```

---

### Key Architectural Layers

| Layer | What It Does |
|-------|-------------|
| **Webhook Router** | Receives Forgejo webhooks, validates HMAC, deduplicates (30s TTL), filters bot events, normalizes payloads into `event.Event` |
| **Event Bus** | Unbounded fan-out pub/sub — events published once, delivered to all subscribers (session managers, lifecycle recorder, SSE streamer) |
| **Session Manager** | Creates/destroys sessions, dispatches events to the right session, handles auto-retry, PM reactivation, role gating, scaffold blocking |
| **Agent + TurnExecutor** | The LLM agent loop: builds system prompt from role + context, runs N turns of LLM → tool calls → results with steering, compaction, cost tracking |
| **Tool Registry** | Thread-safe registry of named tools. Supports role-based tool sets, scoped writes (for parallel agents), and exclusion lists |
| **LLM Provider** | OpenAI-compatible chat client with retry policy (exponential backoff + jitter), cost calculation, fallback provider |
| **Lifecycle** | SQLite session transition logger + issue FSM (12 states: opened → ready → implementing → review → done + blocked/planning) |
| **Merge Coordination** | Stale gate (auto-rebase), merge queue (file overlap blocking), scheduler (dependency tracking via `Depends on: #N`), automerge (label-based) |
| **Cost + Metrics** | Per-session/provider/model token tracking in SQLite; Prometheus counters at `/metrics` |

---

### Role-Based Design

Each session has a **role** that determines: (1) which LLM provider it uses, (2) which tools are available, (3) the system prompt content.

| Role | Tools | Max Turns | Model |
|------|-------|-----------|-------|
| **PM** | read_file, forgejo_comment/issue/milestone, list tools | 10 | Qwen/whatever |
| **Implementer** | write_file, bash, git, forgejo_create_pr/merge, all read tools | 50 | devstral/Qwen |
| **Reviewer** | forgejo_merge_pr (+ approval check), read tools | 20 | GLM/Qwen |
| **DevOps** | Same as implementer | 50 | — |
| **Tester** | Same as implementer | 50 | — |

The Forgejo API client is swapped per-role using role-specific tokens — all PRs/comments appear as the correct bot user (`djent-dev`, `djent-qa`, `djent-pm`).

---

### Parallel Agent Safety (Bug Fix 30+)

When multiple agents work simultaneously, each gets a **scope prefix** extracted from the issue title/body (e.g., `pkg/math/`):
- `write_file` rejects paths outside scope
- `bash` file-writing commands blocked for out-of-scope targets  
- Build/test gate runs scoped paths only (`go test ./pkg/math/` not `./...`)

---

### Persistence

Everything lives in SQLite (`sessions.db`, `lifecycle.db`, `costs.db`) plus JSONL memory files per session in `{workdir}/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{N}/memory.jsonl`.
